HOperatorTrace.projected_operator_kernel_trace.{u_2, u_3} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] {X : Type u_3} [MeasurableSpace X]
  (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (V : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V)
  (E : Submodule ℂ ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) [E.HasOrthogonalProjection] (u : ι → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (hu : Orthonormal ℂ u) (hspan : Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range u) = E)
  (A : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) :
  ∫ (x : X),
      ∑ i,
        HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(u i)) (↑↑((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) (u i))) x
          x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu =
    Masullo.TraceClass.trace (E.starProjection.comp A)

theorem HOperatorTrace.nuclear_kernel_trace_shells.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : ∀ {κ : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [Countable κ]
  [inst : MeasurableSpace X] {J : Type u_3} [Countable J] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) →
    ∀ (V : ℝ),
      0 < V →
        ∀ (T : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (u v : κ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
          (Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖) →
            (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)), HasSum (fun i => ⟪u i, F⟫_ℂ • v i) (T F)) →
              ∀ (p : J → X → ℝ),
                ReviewM.PositivePartition p →
                  Integrable (fun x => ∑' (i : κ), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(v i)) (↑↑(u i)) x x)
                      (ENNReal.ofReal V • nu) ∧
                    ∫ (x : X),
                          ∑' (i : κ), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(v i)) (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu =
                        Masullo.TraceClass.trace T ∧
                      HasSum
                        (fun j =>
                          ∫ (x : X),
                            ↑(p j x) *
                              ∑' (i : κ),
                                HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(v i)) (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu)
                        (Masullo.TraceClass.trace T) :=
fun {κ} {X} [Countable κ] [MeasurableSpace X] {J} [Countable J] nu b hb V hV T u v hc hT p hp =>
  have hc' := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun x => Summable x) (funext fun i => mul_comm ‖v i‖ ‖u i‖))) hc;
  ⟨(HNormalizedKernel.nuclear_diagonal_integrable nu b hb V hV v u hc').left,
    ⟨HOperatorTrace.nuclear_kernel_trace nu b hb V hV T u v hc hT,
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              HasSum
                (fun j =>
                  ∫ (x : X),
                    ↑(p j x) *
                      ∑' (i : κ), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(v i)) (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu)
                _a)
            (HOperatorTrace.nuclear_trace T u v hc hT)))
        (HNormalizedKernel.nuclear_diagonal_shells nu b hb V hV v u hc' p hp).left⟩⟩

HOperatorTrace.nuclear_kernel_trace_shells.{u_1, u_2, u_3} {κ : Type u_1} {X : Type u_2} [Countable κ]
  [MeasurableSpace X] {J : Type u_3} [Countable J] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (V : ℝ)
  (hV : 0 < V) (T : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (u v : κ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (hc : Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖)
  (hT : ∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)), HasSum (fun i => ⟪u i, F⟫_ℂ • v i) (T F)) (p : J → X → ℝ)
  (hp : ReviewM.PositivePartition p) :
  Integrable (fun x => ∑' (i : κ), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(v i)) (↑↑(u i)) x x) (ENNReal.ofReal V • nu) ∧
    ∫ (x : X), ∑' (i : κ), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(v i)) (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu =
        Masullo.TraceClass.trace T ∧
      HasSum
        (fun j =>
          ∫ (x : X),
            ↑(p j x) * ∑' (i : κ), HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b V (↑↑(v i)) (↑↑(u i)) x x ∂ENNReal.ofReal V • nu)
        (Masullo.TraceClass.trace T)
